title: The Breath That Is a Letter
label: ch:bn-breath-is-a-letter
canDo: I can write eight Bengali consonants as cells of one grid — lips, teeth, roof and throat, each with the voice and the breath switched on or off — and read আবার and ভালো with them.

payoff.summary: The eighth consonant closes a grid rather than lengthening a list: the chapter's whole set written back from the four places of articulation, with the two words it made readable.
